Name: Mountain-Town Warp
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
The Mountain and Town maps have been tweaked to allow your farmer some more navigation freedom! You can run up the left side of the river, and continue up to the mountain lake. There have also been some ~widenings~ so you don't have to dismount your horse around town!

I used vanilla tiles to tweak the maps, so any recolours you have should still work.

Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]Install PyTK[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]Install TMX Map Toolkit[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269][/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]To move bushes, type "world_bushreset" into the SMAPI console.
[/list]
